films.title: L'Odissea
films.description: Rossi's RAI Odyssey keeps Peisistratus beside Telemachus on the road from Pylos to Sparta — Nestor's youngest son as the companion who shares the chariot and the search for Odysseus.

popCulture.title: Odyssey
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Homer's Peisistratus welcomes Telemachus at Pylos and rides with him to Menelaus — the Neleid prince as model guest-friend on the Telemachy.

popCulture.title: Peisistratus (son of Nestor)
popCulture.description: Youngest son of Nestor — carefully distinct from the later Athenian tyrant Pisistratus who claimed descent from him.

popCulture.title: Telemachus
popCulture.description: Peisistratus' traveling companion — Odysseus' son whose Pylian friendship opens the road to Sparta and news of his father.

popCulture.title: Nestor
popCulture.description: Peisistratus' father — the aged counselor of the Iliad whose youngest son hosts the next generation's quest.
